segments.name: specialty pharmaceutical products
segments.description: Specialty pharmaceutical company that acquires, develops and commercializes branded prescription medicines for hospital acute care, gastroenterology and oncology in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment which is specialty pharmaceutical products.

revenueModel.text: Independent pharmaceutical wholesalers, hospitals and international partners pay for branded prescription pharmaceuticals; government and managed care organizations receive rebates on filled prescriptions.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of the Company's products are distributed through independent pharmaceutical wholesalers.
